description: The University of the West of Scotland team publishes 720 public-network measurements from 15 Glasgow locations, collected on 6–8 April 2025. Two Android devices sampled four operators, EE, O2, Vodafone and Sky Mobile, to compare received signal conditions and mobile service performance across city environments. The Zenodo deposit provides an Excel workbook, documentation and Python analysis material under CC BY 4.0, allowing free access and reuse with attribution. Observations are discrete campaign measurements, not a continuous citywide traffic or coverage feed. Their location and measurement fields can help calibrate urban wireless scenarios and compare simulated public-network performance. The private-5G laboratory observations discussed in the associated article are not released in this deposit. Device differences, the short observation window and the selected locations limit generalisation; the metadata also contains ambiguous signal-strength wording that users should resolve against the variables. The dataset complements data-slovak-ran-performance-counters, which reports operator-side utilisation and energy counters instead of handset measurements. The former rejection based only on campaign size does not remove its value for reuse.
